from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8272e8ea.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
    dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)

for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo[r][c]=1
result=mod.transform(demo)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: expected[r][c]=2
